name: blend_drag_held_to_perch_sit
facing: front (drops in from above, lands seated on the edge)
generator: Grok Imagine image-to-video (GenerateVideo, 720p, first=last frame = source still) + generated_v2/_tools/build_clip.py
keying: white flood-fill key + enclosed-hole removal (size/purity or isnet-anime matte) + matte trim (_tools/key_white.py)
engine_note: One-shot landing transition (climb_on_land take v1_b) into perch_sit. NOT yet played by the engine: run.rs land() goes straight to Mode::Perched and the brain resets to its base on DragEnd; wiring needs a landing path that starts the perch_sit seat directly and plays this blend first. v2 bakes secondary motion; mute engine springs while it plays.
notes: Landing transition drag_held -> perch_sit (take climb_on_land_v1_b): she drops in from above the window and lands seated in the perch_sit ledge pose. Video frames 5-143 step 2 at 12 fps (frames 1-3 of the take are blank and were trimmed); top of the body is cut off during the first ~1 s drop-in (frames 0-10 touch y~10), as in the take. Built at scale 0.559 with --cx-src 634.2 and shifted -15 px so the final frames sit on y240 like perch_sit; ends in the same ledge pose and seat line as the perch_sit variants (cleavage_beckon/chest_press_tease geometry). deshadow.py rows 150-300; no ledge shadow left. Seat fields measured as for perch_sit (seat_y on final frames 64-69).

seat_align.note: whole clip shifted -15 then +11 px (net -4 vs build): the second shift registers the body to perch_sit frame 0 (alpha-IoU fit on frame 0, scale 1.0), so the body sits exactly where perch_sit's does; seat_y stays 240 like perch_sit

tail_zone_never_mixed.except: opaque pink stocking in both sources (blended)

perch_sit_handoff.method: premultiplied-alpha smoothstep crossfade with perch_sit frame 0 at the clip ends; inside the tail zone (x >= 205, y >= 244, except stocking pixels that are pink in both sources) pixels are taken whole from whichever source weighs >= 0.5, so only one tail ever shows

top_fade.note: drop-in frames sliced flat by the top of the source video: alpha faded in over the 30 rows below the cut

seat_note: Remeasured after the perch_sit hand-off fix (release-2 QA): the body is registered to perch_sit frame 0 (alpha IoU ~0.95 at scale 1.0, so no rescale), so her hips/thighs rest on the same line as perch_sit and seat_y = 240 (perch_sit's value). The hands-span method gives 240 on the eased end frames and ~250 mid-clip only because her fingers curl further over the edge than perch_sit's flat hands. seat_x_range = p5/p95 of the opaque run containing x=200 on rows 232/236/240 over all frames; feet_lowest_y = max lowest opaque row (alpha > 128) over all frames.

matte_clean.main_d93ae0c_post_fix: after matte_clean --include-locked: residual edge un-mix; enclosed near-white neutral backdrop pockets (hair/neck, limb gaps) set transparent; body parts and skin/tattoo holes removed by the clean restored from the pre-clean sheet; fringeqa white/halo and white_edge light-edge px recoloured to nearest interior colour (alpha kept)

tail_fix.what: tail spade floated detached on f57-67: in the source take (climb_on_land_v1_b, video 119-139) the tail line itself stops ~15 px above the spade from about f59 on, and keying/matte trim thinned the line to broken dashes. Per frame: the registered raw frame restores the dark, low-saturation tail-line pixels in x228-285 y262-342 (alpha only raised, colour from the nearest opaque tail pixel), then a 2 px antialiased quadratic stroke in the tail colour continues the line from its end (256,303) along its direction to the nearest spade pixel. Detached islands on f57-67: 11 -> 0; one tail; frames 68-69 (perch_sit hand-off) unchanged.
